meta.title: AirBed & Breakfast — Seed Pitch 2008
meta.subtitle: Book rooms with locals, rather than hotels
meta.team: Brian Chesky, Joe Gebbia, Nathan Blecharczyk

slides.headline: AirBed & Breakfast: Book rooms with locals, rather than hotels
slides.subhead: A peer-to-peer web marketplace for short-term lodging worldwide
slides.speaker_notes: Good morning. We are AirBed and Breakfast, a marketplace that allows travelers to book unique rooms with locals rather than expensive hotels.

slides.headline: Price, cultural disconnect, and unmonetized spare rooms create massive travel friction

left.title: Traveler Lodging Pain
body: Price is a primary concern for online travel bookers
Hotels leave travelers isolated from local city culture
Surge pricing during major conferences locks out attendees

right.title: Homeowner Opportunity
body: Millions of homeowners have vacant spare rooms and couches
No structured, secure web platform to monetize extra space
Craigslist lacks profiles, payments, reviews, and trust

slides.speaker_notes: Travelers face three core problems: high hotel prices, hotel isolation, and no easy way for homeowners to monetize spare rooms.

slides.headline: A web platform where travelers book spaces with locals, saving money while hosts earn income
slides.label: Platform Take Rate Commission
body: Search by city, budget, and event dates
Verified two-sided host and guest profiles with ratings
Secure payment escrow with instant online reservation
slides.speaker_notes: We offer a web platform where hosts make money from extra space and travelers save money while experiencing local culture.

slides.headline: Over 1.9 billion worldwide trips create an enormous $200M serviceable obtainable market
slides.speaker_notes: Total addressable market is 1.9 billion trips worldwide. Budget and online trips represent 560 million, and capturing just 10.6 million trips produces $200M in revenue.

slides.headline: 630,000 Couchsurfing hosts and 17,000 weekly Craigslist listings prove active market demand

cards.title: CouchSurfing (630k Users)
body: 630,000 people host travelers for free
Proves cultural willingness to open homes
Lacks transaction monetization

cards.title: Craigslist (17k Ads/Wk)
body: 17,000 temporary housing ads weekly in SF/NYC
Active commercial demand exists
Lacks safety, reviews, and escrow

cards.title: Events (100% Sold Out)
body: Denver DNC 27k attendees sold out hotels
AirBed hosts booked 100+ rooms in 1 week
Proves instant event liquidity

slides.speaker_notes: Market validation is proven: 630k people use CouchSurfing to host strangers, while 17,000 temporary housing ads are posted on Craigslist weekly.

slides.headline: Two distribution engines drive $0 customer acquisition and rapid host liquidity
slides.speaker_notes: Our dual distribution strategy combines high-profile event targeting with an automated Craigslist cross-posting tool that acquires hosts and guests for $0.

slides.headline: A 10% take rate on $240 average bookings generates $200M in annual net revenue
slides.label: Annual Net Revenue Opportunity (SOM)
body: Average booking: $80 per night across 3 nights stay ($240 total)
AirBed & Breakfast charges a combined 10% commission ($24/booking)
Zero inventory ownership and zero physical facility overhead
slides.speaker_notes: Our business model is simple: 10% fee on every booking. On an average $240 trip, we earn $24. At 10.6 million trips, that is a $200 million net revenue run-rate.

slides.headline: Direct online transactions, host profiles, and trust systems create structural defensibility

cards.title: Craigslist / Classifieds
body: Offline cash payments
No verified user identities
No guest or host ratings
Unsafe and unmonetized

cards.title: Hotels & Hostels
body: High price per night ($150-$300)
Impersonal commercial experience
Fixed inventory capacity constraints
High operational CapEx

cards.title: AirBed & Breakfast
body: 3-click online payment escrow
Two-sided verified profiles & reviews
Affordable local pricing ($80/night)
Asset-light unlimited supply

slides.speaker_notes: Unlike Craigslist, we handle secure online payments, profiles, and reviews. Unlike hotels, we have unlimited peer-to-peer inventory and lower pricing.

slides.headline: Clear operational roadmap to achieve 80,000 transactions and $2M revenue in Year 1

phases.label: Q1: Seed & Product
items: Launch instant booking and review system

slides.speaker_notes: Our 12-month roadmap focuses on product trust, scaling top metropolitan markets, and hitting 80,000 completed bookings.

slides.headline: Raising $500,000 angel round to reach 80,000 transactions and $2M revenue in 12 months
body: 12-month runway to reach profitability and 80,000 completed transactions
Team: Brian Chesky (CEO), Joe Gebbia (CPO), Nathan Blecharczyk (CTO)
Join us in redefining global travel and creating the world's largest peer-to-peer lodging network
